item.title: Persistent rubbish at Fairfield Road Car Park, Beckenham, 22nd August
item.description:
Hello, I would like to report the ongoing problem with rubbish at Fairfield Road Car Park in Beckenham The car park is regularly in a very poor condition. The recycling bins are overflowing, with rubbish left around them, and litter is also scattered across other parts of the car park. This is not a one-off issue, but something I see here repeatedly Could you please arrange for the area to be cleaned and, more importantly, review the frequency of waste collection and cleaning at this car park? The current arrangements do not appear to be sufficient to keep the area reasonably clean Kind regards, Aleksandr

item.title: Major overgrowth still obstructing public footpath – previous report incorrectly marked fixed, 22nd August
item.description:
I previously reported serious overgrowth from the playing fields obstructing the public footpath at this location. I have now been informed that the issue has been fixed. It has not been fixed. The vegetation is still significantly encroaching onto the pavement and pedestrians are still being forced towards the edge of the kerb and the live road in order to get past. This is particularly dangerous for parents with young children, people using pushchairs or wheelchairs, and anyone with limited mobility. Please reopen/investigate this issue and arrange for the vegetation to be properly cut back so that the full usable width of the public footpath is restored. I would also ask that the issue is not marked as resolved again until the obstruction has actually been removed. This is a recurring problem at this location and should ideally be included in a regular maintenance schedule rather than being allowed to reach this condition each year.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Swingate Lane, Plumstead
Report on FixMyStreet
